features.label: The letters outrank the poems
features.detail: Letters to a Young Poet is more read than the poetry. Starting there is fine, and worth being honest about.

features.label: Waited ten years
features.detail: For the Duino Elegies to finish arriving. The long silence is part of the work, not a gap in it.

features.label: Beauty as terror
features.detail: His line about beauty being the beginning of terror is not decorative. It is the entire position.
